verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs say it builds fast, reliable applications that scale with team size. The claimed mechanisms are an opinionated, modular structure (components plus dependency injection), fine-grained Signals reactivity, and an official style guide. Community reports add support: production apps with great performance, AOT and tree-shaking, and >100k SLOC apps maintained without major issues when the style guide is followed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party guidance on scaling large codebases (e.g., lazy loading, code-splitting, performance budgets), and independent hands-on corroboration for modern Angular at large scale. The negative performance reports concern legacy AngularJS digest dirty-checking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build large applications that stay fast and maintainable as my team and codebase grow

citations.quote: Trusted by millions to build fast, reliable applications that scale with the size of your team
Opinionated & versatile, organized yet modular thanks to Angular components and dependency injection
Reactive and fast state updates with fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals
Angular is cross-platform, fast, scalable, has incredible tooling, and is loved by millions.
